action_description: a fast 2-hit sword combo seen from the front, the character keeps facing the camera and attacks TOWARD the camera, toward the bottom of the picture: (1) he steps forward (down the screen) and slashes the sword in a wide horizontal arc in front of him from left to right; (2) straight from there he raises the sword overhead and chops down hard in front of him, then returns to his ready stance. Quick wind-up and clear follow-through, the red scarf-cape whips behind him. A bright white-blue slash arc follows the blade on each swing, in front of him (below him on the screen). Keep the front view in every frame, do not turn sideways, same size, no smoke, no dust.
